slippage_tolerance_percent.meaning: slippage protection percentage Alice sets on her Router swap transaction at submission

eth_price_at_submission.meaning: ETH price in USD at the time Alice submits her swap transaction

eth_price_before_inclusion.meaning: ETH price in USD after the transaction has sat in the mempool and before it is included

tx_pending_hours.meaning: Alice's swap transaction sat in the mempool for hours due to network congestion

executed_within_deadline.meaning: the Router swap transaction is executed within a deadline/expiry bound rather than at an arbitrarily later time

user_value_received.meaning: the user receives far less value than intended from the executed swap

assumptions: Alice's swap transaction is a Router swap submitted with 1% slippage protection at ETH = $2000.
The mempool delay and ETH price drop to $1500 occur before the transaction is included.
The selected impact is potential: the report describes a scenario in which the user may receive far less value than intended.

unresolved.description: Report gives no numeric deadline/expiry bound; the deadline absence is qualitative, so the deadline relation is represented as a grounded Boolean rather than a numeric time bound.
Report does not state whether the $1500 execution is an observed transaction or a hypothetical scenario, so the potential impact cannot be asserted as certain.

limitations: The plan formalizes only the selected impact user_receives_far_less_value; other listed impacts are not covered by this claim.
The deadline relation is represented as a Boolean because the report provides no numeric expiry bound.
The potential modality of the impact is preserved by treating the less-value outcome as a scenario qualifier rather than an inevitable effect.
